title: Add token micro-timeline view and alert calibration GUI
author: Aisha Khan
description:
Motivation: We need a compact, developer-friendly surface for investigating long-tail token cost spikes and latency microbursts without pulling full traces. Existing dashboards surface aggregate token cost/latency but make it hard to correlate per-invocation micro-timeline events (queue/batch/kernels/kv) to alert triggers. This PR adds a Token Micro-Timeline panel and an interactive Alert Calibration GUI to iterate alert thresholds against sampled invocations.

Summary of changes: Added a new React panel under Observability -> Invocation Explorer called TokenMicroTimeline. The panel shows a compact per-token sparkline with phase annotations (queue, scheduling, kernel, decode), per-token cost attribution slices, and trace-deeplink buttons. Introduced an Alert Calibration modal that replays a sample of invocations against candidate threshold curves (by percentile and burstiness) and reports expected false positive/negative rates. Server-side: added a lightweight /observability/microtimeline API that composes sampled span fragments and token cost rollups for the UI. Telemetry: emit microtimeline_sample_id and calibration_run_id as trace tags to correlate back to traces.

Why this is different: Instead of heavy full-trace hydration, the micro-timeline assembles a reduced fingerprint (sparse spans + token cost histogram) that is fast to fetch and good enough for human triage. The calibration GUI lets SREs tune alert bands with immediate preview and exports a recommended alert spec.

Checklist: - [x] UI panel implementation and unit tests - [x] API endpoint + integration tests - [x] Feature flag (observability.microtimeline) - [x] Add telemetry tags and schema migration notes - [x] Docs page (Observability -> Token Micro-Timeline) - [x] Performance bench to ensure 95th percentile fetch < 200ms for 99th percentile shard sizes

Commits (high level): - 7b9d1c2 add microtimeline backend API and lightweight assembler - c4f3a9d ui: token microtimeline panel with sparklines and annotations - 8d3f7b1 add alert calibration modal + replay harness - aa2e5e4 metrics: emit microtimeline_sample_id and calibration_run_id - b33f4b0 tests: add integration tests for microtimeline endpoint - f9a8c1e docs: add observability guide and runbook section - 1c2d3e4 perf: tighten database query to use prefetched span index

Files touched (high level): - observability/ui/components/TokenMicroTimeline.tsx - observability/ui/components/AlertCalibrationModal.tsx - observability/server/microtimeline/assembler.go - observability/server/api_routes.go (adds /observability/microtimeline) - telemetry/schemas/microtimeline.yaml - docs/observability/token-microtimeline.md - tests/integration/test_microtimeline_api.py - tests/ui/token_microtimeline.test.tsx and small CSS + i18n strings

Review conversation (excerpt): Reviewer Evan Brooks: "Nice surface — can we make sure the token phase colors are consistent with existing phase legends? Also worried about query cardinality for large tenants." Author (Aisha): "Good call on colors — aligned with phase legend and added constants in ui/styles/phases.ts. For cardinality I added sampling by tenant hotkeys and a server-side cap with explicit response headers that indicate sampling ratio." Reviewer Monica Chen: "Calibration modal is great. How deterministic is the replay harness? We need reproducibility for RCAs." Author: "Replay harness accepts a seed parameter; default is time-based but we surface the seed in the modal and include it in calibration_run_id tag. Added tests to assert deterministic outputs when seed is fixed." Reviewer Ravi Patel: "Can the API payload be cached at the CDN edge?" Author: "Payloads are tenant-scoped and include short-lived sampling metadata; we add Cache-Control: private,max-age=30 and an ETag for 304s. Also added a telemetry flag to opt-out of CDN caching for regulated tenants." Reviewer Evan Brooks (approval): "LGTM after nits."

CI Summary: - unit tests: pass - integration tests: pass - ui snapshot tests: updated snapshots included - lint: pass - e2e: flaky on first run; retried and passed on second run

Performance and safety: The microtimeline assembler was bench-tested against 10k synthetic sampled invocations and median response 85ms, 95th 170ms. Added a server-side timeout of 500ms and a graceful partial response mode that includes an explanation header when truncated. Feature gated behind observability.microtimeline and rollout to 10% of tenants initially.

Release notes: "Observability: added Token Micro-Timeline panel for per-token cost/latency inspection and an Alert Calibration GUI to preview and export tuned alert specs. Feature gated and rolled out gradually."

Follow-ups: - ENG-4200: add persisted calibration recipes and role-based access to exported specs - ENG-4211: add synthetic microtimeline replay generator for on-demand reproduction - runbook update and short demo for SRE rotation

Merge: Squash-merged to main after approvals and CI green. Rollout: enabled via feature flag in release 2026-02-26 canary and metrics will be monitored for increased load.

Backwards compatibility: No breaking API changes. Telemetry schema bump documented in telemetry/schemas/CHANGELOG.md.

Notes for oncall: If microtimeline API error rates spike, the UI will fall back to full-trace deeplinks and we surface a banner. Key alerts to watch: observability.microtimeline.api_error_rate > 1% over 5m, observability.microtimeline.avg_latency > 300ms over 5m.

Links: Linear tasks ENG-4182, ENG-4190. Demo recording (internal): https://videos.redwood/observability/microtimeline-demo (internal).
